_comment: Single source of truth for AI surfaces and the transitions between them (P43). Consumed by tools/wizard.py (/chatgpt, /transitions, /cross-modality) and mirrored by docs/TRANSITIONS.md. Drift invariant 32 keeps the JSON, the doc, and the wizard surface keys consistent. Every OpenAI or Google product claim this repo cannot verify from cited research carries a literal [NEEDS VERIFICATION: ...] tag; treat those as things to check against your own plan, never as facts.
_residual_origin_note: origin 'other' is the forward-compatibility residual in tools/handoff/queue.py ALLOWED_ORIGINS; it names no surface by design and is claimed here so invariant 55's origin-coverage check is total.

claude_desktop.label: Claude Desktop (this computer)
setup_steps: Install Claude Desktop into ~/Applications (per-user) and keep your Creator OS folder on this computer; everything Creator OS installs stays inside your user account (docs/INSTALL-SCOPE.md).
Run the wizard (python3 tools/wizard.py) and pick Claude Desktop; it writes the MCP entries to your Claude Desktop config.
Restart Claude Desktop; the Creator OS tools appear automatically.

claude_code.label: Claude Code / command line
setup_steps: Open a terminal in your Creator OS folder.
Run tools directly (python3 tools/...), or use the same MCP server as Claude Desktop.

claude_web.label: claude.ai in a browser (web and mobile)
setup_steps: Claude chat and Cowork are one Claude as of 2026-09-16 (support article 16761823, fetched 2026-09-20); rollout is staged from Pro and Max, so accounts may still show the pre-merge UI for a while. Skills, plugins, and connectors work from any conversation in the merged experience.

Fastest path: the setup wizard's guided claude.ai lane (python3 tools/wizard.py on the maintainer's computer) walks the four doors with copy buttons, a staged upload folder, and paste-back verification (P90).

Best door on a paid plan: install the Creator OS plugin (Customize, then Plugins; a GitHub-repo marketplace can be added by URL per support article 13837440). Skills and connectors then work in any conversation; deeper automation runs in agentic sessions.

Knowledge door, any plan: add the Creator OS knowledge files to a claude.ai Project, either by uploading them or by connecting the GitHub repository to the Project's knowledge and selecting implementation/claude/project/ (sync is manual via Sync now; support article 10167454). Free plans are capped at five projects (support article 9517075).

Individual skills, any plan: enable code execution (Settings, then Capabilities), then upload a self-contained skill ZIP under Customize, then Skills (support article 12512180). Skills that reference repo-root shared/ paths need the plugin door instead.

For live tools, you or your developer must deploy the remote MCP endpoint behind HTTPS with authentication (implementation/gpt/mcp-connector/README.md), then add it under Customize, then Connectors (Free plans can hold one custom connector; support article 11176164).

Agentic tasks started from a conversation run in a cloud sandbox that is cleared when the task ends: keep stateful data in Google Drive or a hosted connector, and reach files on this computer only through Claude Desktop with its trusted folders (support article 16761823).
needs_verification: plan gating of the GitHub-to-project-knowledge connector (support article 10167454 does not state plans)

chatgpt_web_plain.label: ChatGPT web chat (plain chat at chatgpt.com)
setup_steps: Fastest path: the setup wizard on the maintainer's computer (python3 tools/wizard.py, the ChatGPT button) copies each paste, stages the exact upload folder for the plan, and verifies the setup from pasted answers (P90).
Open ChatGPT Settings, then Personalization, then Custom Instructions.
Paste the two boxes from implementation/gpt/web/custom-instructions.md (the file tells you which text goes in which box).
This is knowledge-only mode: no live data, no local tools, no capability flags. Numbers you did not supply in the chat are never real Creator OS data.
At the start of a session, upload your latest dated export file if you keep one (see the read-back steps in docs/TRANSITIONS.md).

To get live tools without leaving ChatGPT, there are two upgrade routes: deploy the MCP connector and add it in ChatGPT developer mode (documented for Business, Enterprise and Edu workspaces on ChatGPT web, help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461; see implementation/gpt/mcp-connector/README.md), or install the local setup and use Claude Desktop. Knowledge-only is what PLAIN chat gives you, not the ceiling of ChatGPT.

With the Google Drive app connected, ChatGPT can create and update files in your Drive when your plan, workspace and the Google permissions allow it, and may ask you to confirm first (help.openai.com/en/articles/10929079). Creator OS treats that as create-only: save each change as a NEW dated file in the hub (docs/DRIVE-HUB.md) and never edit or move a file the computer manages.
needs_verification: Google Drive app write actions depend on plan, workspace and Google permissions (help.openai.com/en/articles/10929079)

chatgpt_projects.label: ChatGPT Projects (a Project with files at chatgpt.com)
setup_steps: Fastest path: the setup wizard on the maintainer's computer (python3 tools/wizard.py, the ChatGPT button) copies each paste, stages the exact upload folder for the plan, and verifies the setup from pasted answers (P90).

Create a Project in ChatGPT (sidebar, New project). Choose PROJECT-ONLY memory so Creator OS work stays separate from your personal chats; the memory setting can be changed later in the project's settings, and project-only memory turns off ChatGPT Work in that project (help article 10169521).
Set the Project instructions to implementation/gpt/project/project-instructions.md (paste the whole file).

Upload the knowledge files from implementation/claude/project/knowledge/ to the Project files area. Published per-project caps (help article 10169521, read in full 2026-09-19): 5 on Free, 25 on Go and Plus, 40 on Edu, Pro, Business, and Enterprise, at most 10 files per simultaneous upload. On Free the separate files do not fit; upload the single combined file implementation/claude/project/creator-os-combined.md instead.
Knowledge-only mode applies: no live tools, no flags. Keep the packaging version line so you can tell when your files are stale.

Custom GPTs retire on 2026-12-11 (help article 20001519, which also names plugins as OpenAI's migration target); Creator OS uses a Project instead, because a Project holds the instructions and knowledge files Creator OS needs.

chatgpt_desktop.label: ChatGPT desktop app
setup_steps: Install the ChatGPT desktop app and sign in. Since July 2026 the app holds Chat, Work and Codex; the previous app stays available as ChatGPT Classic (help.openai.com/en/articles/20001276).
For knowledge-only use, paste implementation/gpt/web/custom-instructions.md into your custom instructions, exactly like the web version. Cloud Work chats you start on the web continue here.

Codex works with local files, repositories and terminals: opened on your Creator OS folder it can run the repo's own tools (python3 tools/...), which read your capability flags, so the flags hold inside Codex. Chat and Work do not run your local tools.

For live Creator OS tools in Chat or Work: a developer-mode MCP connector to your deployed endpoint (implementation/gpt/mcp-connector/README.md). [NEEDS VERIFICATION: developer mode with write actions is documented for Business, Enterprise and Edu workspaces on ChatGPT web (help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461); the desktop app is not named there.]
Capability flags are not enforced in Chat or Work; a connector endpoint enforces its own gates on the machine where it runs.
needs_verification: developer-mode MCP connector on the desktop app (help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461 names ChatGPT web)
whether Codex in the desktop app can write to a Drive-for-desktop folder outside the opened project

gemini_api.label: Gemini API (developer integration)
setup_steps: Load implementation/gemini/*function-declarations.json as functionDeclarations in your app.
When Gemini returns a function call, YOUR app executes the HTTPS request and returns the result.
Flags are enforced only if your backend runs the Creator OS Python tools.

gemini_web.label: Gemini web app (gemini.google.com)
setup_steps: Paste implementation/gemini/system-instruction.md at the start of a chat. On a personal Google Account you can instead save it as a skill: Settings, then Skills, then Create manually, or upload it as a SKILL.md on the web app or the Mac app (support.google.com/gemini/answer/17094296). Gems are retired: Google turns them into skills from November 2026 for personal accounts and in 2027 for work and school accounts (support.google.com/gemini/answer/18560919).
Attach the hub's "About me and my voice" Doc to the chat from Google Drive when a reply should use your voice; the chat reads the Doc as it is when you attach it.
Export to Docs saves a NEW Google Doc in your Drive (support.google.com/gemini/answer/14184041); move it into the hub's Inbox folder so the computer picks it up.

Optional, for live tools: connect the deployed Creator OS MCP endpoint as a custom app in Settings, then Connected Apps (support.google.com/gemini/answer/17209137). Capability flags are not enforced here; the endpoint enforces its own gates.
needs_verification: custom MCP apps require the US, 18 or over, a personal Google Account, English and Keep Activity on (support.google.com/gemini/answer/17209137)
Export to Docs lands in My Drive; choosing the hub folder is not documented (support.google.com/gemini/answer/14184041)

gemini_desktop.label: Gemini desktop app (Mac and Windows)
setup_steps: Mac: macOS 15 or later on Apple Silicon (support.google.com/gemini/answer/17011627). Windows: Windows 10 or later; more native features are rolling out over time (blog.google, 2026-09-10).

Gemini Spark on the Mac can analyze, edit, rename and reorganize folders you connect, makes changes by default and can permanently delete files (support.google.com/gemini/answer/17208717). Connect only the hub's Inbox folder, never your Creator OS folder.
Creator OS tools do not run here and capability flags are not enforced. Hand work to the computer by saving a NEW dated file into the hub's Inbox.
needs_verification: Drive writes from the desktop app are documented only through Spark-connected Mac folders; Export to Docs is documented for web and mobile (support.google.com/gemini/answer/14184041)
custom MCP apps are documented for the web and mobile apps, not the desktop app (support.google.com/gemini/answer/17209137)

needs_export: the knowledge pack (custom-instructions.md, pasted into ChatGPT settings)
your freshness or task data as a dated export file (export-and-you-save)
stops_working: all Class C tools: finance math, document-template assembly, obligation date math, the deterministic quality score
capability flag enforcement (nothing evaluates your local config there)
all local stores: rate card, deals, contracts, templates, profile
reimport_steps: paste the two custom-instruction boxes once
at the start of each ChatGPT session, upload your latest dated export file if you want it considered
flags_unenforced: ALL capability flags: contract, finance, publishing, templates
notes: Read docs/PASTE-SAFETY.md before pasting anything: rate card numbers, contract text, and personal identity details do not belong in a third-party chat without a deliberate decision.

needs_export: the Project instructions (implementation/gpt/project/project-instructions.md) and the knowledge files (implementation/claude/project/knowledge/, or the single combined file on Free)
reimport_steps: set Project instructions to the instruction file
upload knowledge files to the Project
re-upload when the packaging version changes
notes: Project file and instruction limits vary by plan [NEEDS VERIFICATION: check your plan].

needs_export: the knowledge pack (paste path), OR nothing if you deploy the remote MCP connector
stops_working: without a deployed connector: everything the plain-web transition loses
with a deployed connector: nothing tool-wise, but flag enforcement happens on the machine running the endpoint, not inside ChatGPT
reimport_steps: paste custom instructions for the knowledge baseline
or deploy the remote MCP endpoint (implementation/gpt/mcp-connector/README.md) and add it as a developer-mode connector [NEEDS VERIFICATION: plan gating]
flags_unenforced: flags are evaluated by the deployed endpoint's machine, never by ChatGPT itself
notes: This is the strongest ChatGPT surface for Creator OS because of the connector option.

needs_export: knowledge files into a claude.ai Project, OR deploy the remote MCP connector for live tools
stops_working: without a connector: Class C tools, flags, local stores
with a connector: nothing tool-wise; flags enforce on the endpoint's machine
reimport_steps: or add the deployed endpoint as a claude.ai custom connector

needs_export: the ChatGPT knowledge pack (claude.ai Project files do not transfer; re-paste the ChatGPT custom instructions)
stops_working: any remote MCP connector you used on claude.ai (PLAIN pasted-instructions ChatGPT cannot use it; a connector added in ChatGPT developer mode can, on web or desktop -- that is a separate setup, not this surface)
reimport_steps: carry data across as dated export files you upload per session
flags_unenforced: ALL capability flags on both surfaces
notes: Neither surface can merge data files; the newest dated file wins. Your computer's tools merge properly when the files come home.

needs_export: your ChatGPT profile answers via the profile-import prompt (implementation/gpt/profile-import/PROMPT.md)
any dated export files you accumulated
reimport_steps: run the profile-import prompt once per ChatGPT context (default chat, each Project, and each custom GPT you still have before custom GPTs retire on 2026-12-11) and paste the JSON back home
the profile-import atom proposes creator-profile.local.json with per-field provenance; you review and save it by hand
drop dated export files into your store folder; the local tools union-merge them automatically
notes: Everything gains enforcement again on this transition: flags, consent gates, deterministic tools.

travels_automatically: your ChatGPT account, chats, memory, and custom instructions (same account)
reimport_steps: optionally add a deployed remote MCP connector in developer mode for live tools [NEEDS VERIFICATION: plan gating]
flags_unenforced: ALL capability flags unless a deployed connector enforces them on its own machine
notes: This is the easiest upgrade: same account, plus the connector option.

needs_export: profile answers via the profile-import prompt
reimport_steps: same as the plain-web return: profile-import proposal, hand-save, drop dated files into the store

travels_automatically: everything: same computer, same files, same tools, same flags
